items.Sentence: The headworks includes a magnetic-type flow meter to measure influent flow, a mechanically cleaned screen, a bypass channel with a bar screen...

Secondary treatment consists of two aeration basins providing a complete mix activated sludge process using extended retention of biological solids... The repeated cycling of environments nitrifies and denitrifies the wastewater... the aeration system can achieve biological nitrogen removal.

Two 50-feet diameter, 16-feet side-water-depth secondary clarifiers remove the biomass associated with the secondary treatment process... The flocculation well... permits natural flocculation of the biomass contained in the mixed liquor.
Two RAS pumps at each clarifier return the settled sludge to the activated sludge process in order to maintain a viable population of the microorganisms...
A waste activated sludge (WAS) pump draws WAS from the RAS discharge piping and pumps the WAS to the biosolids storage basin.
A constant-speed submersible pump will be used to pump scum from the secondary clarifiers directly to the biosolids storage basin.
Secondary effluent can either flow by gravity or be pumped to the chlorine contact basins where chlorine solution is used to achieve disinfection and sulfur dioxide solution is used to dechlorinate.
Solids handling consists of pumping WAS from the secondary clarifiers to a biosolids storage basin.
During dry weather, effluent is recycled for dry-weather maintenance of the Hiller storm water treatment wetland...

The Permittee also has the option of recycling effluent through irrigation on the northern portion of the former Fisher parcel north of the railroad bridge, on the lower Fisher Ranch, or on the West Pialorsi Ranch.
